attempts.exactPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-cave-bear-fire".

Subject and threat:
- Species: cave-bear.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: close-range-bruiser.
- Construction mode: organic-quadruped.

Identity invariants:
- recognizable ursine face
- heavy shoulder mass
- powerful forelimbs

Anatomy invariants:
- ursine anatomy
- exactly four legs
- four-legged weight distribution

Affinity: fire.
Affinity expression: heat-blackened surfaces, internal ember seams, controlled combustion, smoke, and heat distortion
Counterplay cue: The internal core or heat sink becomes exposed between combustion cycles.
Altered dimensions: material; motion; attack-telegraph; environmental-wake.
Permitted transformations: material; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: wolf proportions; humanoid golem anatomy; decorative saddle or rider; a uniform orange full-body glow that destroys material and anatomy detail.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one subject; entire creature and every extremity visible, centered with finished detail across the canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/review/beasts-v1.webp — Third subject only: established Cave Bear anatomy, coat, grounded mass, and shoulder weight; do not transfer either wolf or the Tunnel Boar.
2. assets/enemies/review/pack-2/monster-grade-escalation-v1.png — Pack 2 realistic dark-fantasy finish and neutral presentation only; do not transfer Grade 7 or 10 scale, anatomy, weapons, glow, or the Tower Archmage.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.

findings.observation: The full canvas is intentionally rendered from the charcoal backdrop through the cracked-stone floor, with no blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt cutoff.
The ears, muzzle, complete back, all four legs, claws, smoke wake, and full silhouette remain inside a clear border on every edge.
Exactly one featured cave bear appears, without a rider, duplicate, or incidental creature.

Blind recognition remains pending human review; known-target inspection finds a broad ursine muzzle, small rounded ears, heavy shoulder hump, powerful forelimbs, short-backed mass, and four-legged bear stance.
Blind affinity recognition remains pending human review; known-target inspection finds scorched load-bearing surfaces, internal ember seams, controlled flame, smoke, and heat wake.

Fire changes the hide material into heat-blackened plated fur with internal ember seams, drives a forward combustion wake, and adds localized smoke and heat distortion rather than a uniform orange wash.
Exactly four coherent ursine legs are visible with powerful forelimbs, credible joints, balanced bruiser mass, and grounded claw contact.
The low head, squared shoulders, planted stride, and massive advancing forequarters clearly communicate a close-range bruiser.

The image preserves a recognizable ursine face, heavy shoulders, powerful forelimbs, four-legged weight distribution, and every prohibited-trait constraint; it does not drift toward wolf or humanoid-golem anatomy.
A concentrated bright chest heat sink is exposed between the darker shoulder masses, making the declared combustion-cycle counterplay readable in the still image.
Premium realistic painterly dark-fantasy finish, readable fur and scorched materials, controlled local emission, cracked floor, and charcoal backdrop remain cohesive.
No text, label, UI, frame, logo, watermark, extra creature, rider, saddle, sexualization, or published-character resemblance is visible.
